first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: The person seated in front of the forward instrument panel with their back to the camera, with short light-brown hair, wearing a black top and light-green over-ear headphones, with a dark gray-green safety harness across the shoulders and back.

entities.name: aircraft cockpit
entities.identification: The cockpit interior surrounding Person A, including light-colored interior walls, dark tubular window frames, a transparent overhead window, an instrument panel, a red recessed panel, and a central wide black band.

entities.name: field
entities.identification: Large expanses of yellow-brown and light-green fields outside the windows, varying in shape and size, with discernible cultivation patterns in some plots.

entities.name: forest belt
entities.identification: Long, narrow dark green-gray vegetation belts and connected wooded areas between the fields, with bending outlines and uneven edges.

entities.name: field road
entities.identification: Light-colored, narrow roads extending between the fields and buildings, including straight sections, curved sections, and junctions.

entities.name: building complex
entities.identification: Buildings scattered among the fields outside the windows, mainly discernible as small, light-colored roofs, with the facades of individual buildings unclear.

entities.name: pond surface
entities.identification: A small turquoise-green water surface near the upper part of the right-side window, with a light-colored shoreline visible along its outer edge.
